description:
Convert a color between hex, rgb, and hsl. Accepts inputs like '#3B82F6', 'rgb(59,130,246)', or 'hsl(217,91%,60%)'.

Returns: JSON with hex, rgb, and hsl representations of the color.
Example input: {"color":"#3b82f6"}
On error, includes hint: `color` accepts #rgb, #rrggbb, rgb(r,g,b), or hsl(h,s%,l%).

color.description: Color in hex, rgb(), or hsl() form.

name: color_convert
title: Color converter
